title: Is the existence of unbounded operators a problem for quantum mechanics? In response to Carcassi, Calderon, and Aidala
summary: In this paper I argue against Carcassi, Calderon, and Aidala's recent claim that the Hilbert spaces are unphysical and should be replaced with the Schwartz spaces in quantum mechanics, since Hilbert spaces include states with infinite expectation values for certain observables. I also review and discuss issues regarding unbounded operators in quantum mechanics raised by Streater and Wightman, Heathcote, and Lemos.
